def analyze2(gin,gout):
    ch={(y,x) for y in range(len(gin)) for x in range(len(gin[0])) if gin[y][x]!=gout[y][x]}
    res=[]
    for comp in zcomps(gin):
        S=set(comp); ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        ring={(y,x) for y in range(max(0,r0-1),min(len(gin)-1,r1+1)) for x in range(max(0,c0-1),min(len(gin[0])-1,c1+1))}-S
        inside=[(y,x) for y,x in ring if 0<=y<len(gin) and 0<=x<len(gin[0])]
        nz=[gin[y][x] for y,x in inside if gin[y][x]!=0]
        framed = all(p in ch for p in inside)
        res.append({'bbox':(r0,r1,c0,c1),'size':len(S),'nInsideRing':len(inside),'nzInRing':len(nz),'uniformNz':len(set(nz))==1,'framed':framed})
    return res
for i,(gin,gout) in enumerate([(di3,do3),(d2,do2),(di,do)],1):
    print(f'--- demo{i}')
    for r_ in analyze2(gin,gout):
        if r_['size']>=2 or (not any(s==1 for _,_,_,_ in [(None,None,None,None)])): pass
        mark='FRAMED' if r_['framed'] else '      '
        print(' ',mark,r_['bbox'],'size',r_['size'],'nIn',r_['nInsideRing'],'nz',r_['nzInRing'],'uni',r_['uniformNz'])

# Which comps got their full bounding-box ring painted accent? Record features for those and non-frauds.
def feats(gin,gout):
    ch={(y,x) for y in range(len(gin)) for x in range(len(gin[0])) if gin[y][x]!=gout[y][x]}
    acc=sorted({gout[y][x] for y,x in ch})[0]
    out=[]
    for comp in zcomps(gin):
        S=set(comp); ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        H=r1-r0+1; W=c1-c0+1
        inn={p for p in {(y,x) for y in range(max(0,r0-1),min(len(gin)-1,r1+1)) for x in range(max(0,c0-1),min(len(gin[0])-1,c1+1))} if p not in S}
        n0=sum(1 for p in inn if gin[p[0]][p[1]]==0)
        full=all(p in ch for p in inn) or len(inn)==0
        # alternative: ring fully painted accent in output
        fullO=all(gout[p[0]][p[1]]==acc for p in inn) if inn else True
        # ratio zero-ring / ring
        fr=n0/len(inn) if inn else 1
        out.append(dict(sz=len(S),H=H,W=W,ring=len(inn),n0=n0,fr=round(fr,2),'full',full,'fullO',fullO,'framed' if fullO else None))
    return out
for i,(gin,gout) in enumerate([(di3,do3),(d2,do2),(di,do)],1):
    print(f'--- demo{i}')
    for o_ in feats(gin,gout):
        tag=o_['framed'] or ('     ' if not o_['framed'] and not o_['full']) else 'FRAM'
        print(' ',tag,o_['sz'],'x',o_['W'],'H',o_['H'],'ring',o_['ring'],'n0',o_['n0'],'frac',o_['fr'])

def solve_rect(gin):
    cs=zcomps(gin)
    cnt=Counter()
    for row in gin:
        for v in row:
            if v!=0: cnt[v]+=1
    accv=cnt.most_common()[-1][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in gin]
    for c_ in cs:
        s=set(c_)
        ys=[p[0] for p in c_]; xs=[p[1] for p in c_]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        if len(c_)!=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1): continue  # must be solid rectangle
        ring=[(a,b) for a in range(r0-1,r1+2) for b in range(c0-1,c1+2)
              if 0<=a<len(gin) and 0<=b<len(gin[0]) and (a,b) not in s]
        if ring and accv==0: continue
        for a,b in ring: out[a][b]=accv
    return out
